svg.title: W-BW-SCREEN east-face finish comparison
svg.desc: Four matched conceptual east elevations: vertical locust slats, shiplap, botanical panels and geometric panels; assembly sections and a dimensioned door plan. Dimensions and quantities are in the companion study. Brace slats and hardware are schematic.

g.text: Finish study · 2026-10-14 · natural black locust / painted Exterior MDO · design comparison, not construction drawings
Matched scale within elevations. South is left; north / garage is right. Existing brace pattern is schematic; preserve its design.
